template.name: Landledger: raise or hold an AI budget
template.description: When a Landflow agent has spent 80% of its monthly AI cap, the agent asks Landledger (with its sponsor) for a higher cap, with the month’s spend and forecast as evidence. If the approvers say yes, the flow raises the agent’s cap through Landflow’s API, publishes it and marks the request applied; otherwise the cap holds.

credentials.name: Landledger
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with requests:write and read. Managing the webhook needs an admin key, or put the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made in Webhook Signing Secret.

credentials.name: Landflow API key
credentials.description: A Landflow API key (lf_…) that can read usage and read, save and publish agents.

setup: Pick or add the **Landledger** credential: the API URL and an `ll_` key with `requests:write` and `read` (and `admin`, or the `whsec_` secret of a webhook an admin made, for **Request decided**).
Add a **Landflow API key** (Settings → API keys) that can read usage and read, save and publish agents.

In **Settings** and **Raise settings**, set `LANDFLOW_URL` to this Landflow (as Landflow reaches itself), the cost center that pays for agents, the sponsor (the person accountable for the agents, not an approver), the threshold and how much to ask for; **Raise settings** caps any raise (`MAX_CAP`).
Agents need a **monthly cost limit** (agent → Settings) for the flow to watch them.
An agent with unpublished edits is held: **Plan the raise** says why, and a person raises its cap by hand.
Publish: Landledger must reach `LANDFLOW_PUBLIC_URL` for request.decided.

workflow.name: Landledger: raise or hold an AI budget
workflow.description: At 80% of an agent’s monthly AI cap, an ai_budget request with the forecast; on approval the cap is raised through Landflow’s API.

nodes.name: Agent AI calls
nodes.notes: Every agent AI call, five minutes at a time: one run reads each agent that spent.

nodes.name: Over the threshold
nodes.notes: Keeps the agents past the threshold of their monthly cap (the published caps, the ones enforced) with the forecast and the cap to ask for.

nodes.name: Ask to raise the cap

parameters.title: Raise {{ $json.agentName }}'s monthly AI cap to ${{ $json.newCap }}
parameters.note: {{ $json.agentName }} has spent ${{ $json.spent }} of its ${{ $json.cap }} monthly cap ({{ $json.share }}%); the month is forecast at ${{ $json.forecast }}. Approve to raise the cap to ${{ $json.newCap }}; reject to hold it (the agent stops at the cap).

requestFields.originTitle: Raise or hold an AI budget

nodes.notes: One request per agent, month and cap: later calls in the month return the same request.

nodes.name: Publish the agent
nodes.notes: Only the cap changed (Plan the raise held any agent with other unpublished edits), so the evaluation gate is skipped.

parameters.appliedNote: {{ $('Plan the raise').item.json.agentName }}'s monthly AI cap raised from ${{ $('Plan the raise').item.json.oldCap }} to ${{ $('Plan the raise').item.json.newCap }} in Landflow.
parameters.links: {{ [{ label: $('Plan the raise').item.json.agentName + ' in Landflow', url: $('Plan the raise').item.json.landflowUrl + '/agents/' + $('Plan the raise').item.json.agentId }] }}

nodes.name: Hold: raise by hand
nodes.notes: Plan the raise says why (the request does not name the agent, the cap is out of range, or the agent has unpublished edits). A person raises it, then marks the request applied in Landledger.

nodes.name: Hold the cap
nodes.notes: Rejected, cancelled or expired: the cap stays and the agent stops at it.
